audit.whatIsWrong: Every phase reason is shared template text, and three of them refer to Fiora as 'he'.
audit.why: Riposte (24s at rank 1) and Lunge (13s at rank 1) are what actually decide each stage; the template named neither and used the wrong pronoun.
audit.corrected: Phase reasons rewritten around Riposte's parry window, Lunge's cooldown and Grand Challenge's vitals, in the user's second-person voice.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spike text tied the first-item window to 'Riposte's cooldown' but never said what changes at 6 or at two items.
audit.why: Fiora's spikes are Riposte rank-ups (24s down to 16s), level 6 Grand Challenge, and her first item; yours are Shroud at 2, Lich Bane, and the 2-item window.
audit.corrected: phases[4] now names Grand Challenge's heal and reveal, phases[5] keys the all-in to Riposte being spent, phases[6] states the duelling limit.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single decisive interaction — Riposte parrying your commit and stunning you out of it — was described only as 'parries your burst + stuns', with no sequencing. Lunge applying on-hit was absent entirely.
audit.why: The kit file flags Riposte hardCC and Lunge onHit. Riposte is 24s at rank 1 against Shuriken Flip's 16s, so you can bait it and still have E back before she does.
audit.corrected: Stated in phases[1].why, breakdown.cooldowns, tradeGood and report[5].t with both numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere in the full layer.
audit.why: Riposte 24/22/20/18/16, Lunge 13/11.25/9.5/7.75/6, Bladework 11s at rank 1, Grand Challenge 110s at rank 1; your E is 16s and W 20s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into winCon, phases[1], phases[3], phases[5] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull and dontsFull descriptions did not match their titles, and 'half his win condition' referred to Fiora as male.
audit.why: Shared template copy across the whole champion file.
audit.corrected: Each description rewritten to explain its own title, with correct pronouns.

edits.before: Bait Riposte and poke her down. Track Riposte before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Bait Riposte and burst her after. It is 24s at rank 1 to your E's 16s — that gap is the lane.

edits.before: Q-poke on energy rhythm wins the chip war. Identify how Fiora contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Lunge lets her walk up to any last hit and Duelist's Dance vitals heal her back. Farm at Q tip and give her nothing.

edits.before: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Only take the trade when Fiora's Riposte is down.
edits.after: Shroud rewrites any trade she starts, but Riposte parries and stuns — bait it first.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Fiora must walk into your range.
edits.after: Full kit online: E-mark her, dash the angle Bladework does not cover, then Shroud the return and take the free Mark auto.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Riposte's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: The lane-control window: her Lunge is down 13s at rank 1, and Riposte 24s. Commit inside those holes, never outside them.

edits.before: Both R casts turn survived all-ins into executes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Fiora's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Both R casts execute, but Grand Challenge heals her off vitals and reveals you — never duel her inside her own ultimate.

edits.before: Lich Bane is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Riposte's cooldown.
edits.after: Lich Bane is your spike — force the fight the instant Riposte is spent on its 24s.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Fiora carry threat 10/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on and your rotation kills, but she out-duels you in a straight fight — pick her, never brawl her side lane.

edits.before: - Fiora Riposte: matchup-defining — Parries your burst + stuns. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Riposte (24s at rank 1): parries your burst and stuns you — bait it, then commit inside the gap. - Lunge (13s): her step-up and her escape. - Grand Challenge (110s): heals off vitals, so never duel inside it.

edits.before: Q Fiora at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Q her at 550, bait Riposte with the kunai, then E-mark and dash in while it is on its 24s.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Opening E into an up Riposte — she parries the dash and stuns you inside her own range.

edits.before: Q Fiora at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Throw a kunai first, never your E — a parried Q costs far less than a parried commit and dash.

edits.before: Fiora wastes Riposte — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Five Point Strike reaches 550 to her 400 Lunge — chip her.

edits.before: That is Fiora's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Riposte parries the dash and stuns you where Bladework and vitals finish the job.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Vitals heal her and set up her ultimate — move after every trade.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Grand Challenge reveals you and heals her off every vital — leave the duel and come back.

edits.before: Track Fiora's Riposte: Parries your burst + stuns. Bait it. When it is down — E-Q + R her.
edits.after: Riposte (24s) parries your burst and stuns you. Bait it with Q, then E in during the gap.

notes: Fiora's Grand Challenge carries a revealsStealth flag in the kit file. Whether that reveal actually pulls Akali out of Twilight Shroud is not stated in Riot's description, so I wrote only 'reveals you' in the general sense and did NOT claim it defeats Shroud — that specific interaction is unverified and worth a hand check. Separately, the full layer refers to Fiora as 'he' in tradeGood, dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[0].d; I fixed those three, but the same masculine template text likely appears in every female-champion matchup in champ-data/akali.full.js and deserves a global sweep.
